subject: three small blue-roof houses on one floating island
art_direction: 三座蓝顶小屋聚在同一悬浮岛上，暖墙与低树形成精细但不拥挤的空中聚落。
visible_description: 三座蓝顶小屋聚在同一悬浮岛上，暖墙与低树形成精细但不拥挤的空中聚落。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create three small blue-roof houses on one floating island. Keep the houses distinct in height and orientation, linked by one short path. Use a single low tree and no fences packed with details. The island underside is compact and softly textured. Warm windows and cool roof reflections provide depth, while the upper fifth remains a broad pale sky without other settlements. Use storybook architectural landscape. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
